title: Specialization of geometric module stalks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, $G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Xi\to S_{(\bar s)}$ a geometric point of the strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Write $\rho:S_{(\bar s)}\to S$ for its structural morphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. The specialization map $sp_{\bar s,\bar t}:G_{\bar s}\to G_{\rho\bar t}$ of geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is the unique $\Lambda$-linear map which, for every affine pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u)$ of $\bar s$ and its limit projection $\pi_U$, sends the germ of any $a\in G(U)$ at $\bar u$ to its germ at $\pi_U\bar t$. The same condition on the small representative category determines the map, by the stalk colimit universal property.
